company_profile.name: PRV Consultancy Services
company_profile.tagline: Empowering Businesses Through Excellence, Compliance & Growth
core_offerings: Audits & Compliance Support (SEDEX, SMETA, MACE, FSSAI)

services.definition: ZED (Zero Defect Zero Effect) is an initiative by the Ministry of MSME, Government of India, to motivate MSMEs to manufacture products with zero defects and minimal environmental impact.
purpose: Eliminate manufacturing defects and rework
Minimize environmental pollution and footprint
Empower Indian MSMEs to become globally competitive
Avail Ministry of MSME subsidies on certification and capital
who_needs_it: Registered Indian Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs)
Manufacturing units with Udyam Registration
Exporters seeking government-backed quality credentials
Companies bidding for government tenders requiring ZED rating
benefits: Govt Subsidy up to 80% on certification cost for eligible MSMEs
Concession on bank loan processing fees and interest rates
Financial support for testing and equipment calibration
Enhanced customer trust and export readiness
process: Gap analysis and PRV documentation guidance
Implementation of quality and environmental controls
Desktop assessment / On-site audit by accredited agency

faqs.question: What are the levels of ZED Certification?
faqs.answer: ZED Certification is awarded at three levels: Bronze, Silver, and Gold, depending on the maturity of quality and environmental parameters implemented.

faqs.question: Can service sector MSMEs apply for ZED?
faqs.answer: Currently, ZED scheme primary focus is on manufacturing MSMEs holding valid Udyam Registration.

services.comparisons: Unlike ISO 9001 which is an international private management standard, ZED is a Government of India scheme specifically for Indian MSMEs with direct financial subsidies.

services.definition: ISO 9001:2015 is the internationally recognized standard for Quality Management Systems (QMS) that helps organizations consistently deliver high-quality products and services.
purpose: Establish standardized operational processes
Enhance customer satisfaction and trust
Implement risk-based thinking and continuous improvement
Qualify for corporate vendor registration and govt tenders
who_needs_it: Manufacturing and engineering firms
Service sector businesses, IT firms, and consultants
SMEs seeking corporate growth and structured operations
Organizations bidding for government Tenders
benefits: Global recognition in over 170 countries
Substantial reduction in customer complaints and shopfloor rework
Mandatory requirement for corporate vendor onboarding
System-driven processes independent of individual personnel
process: Initial gap analysis of existing workflows
Quality Manual, SOPs, and Process Chart preparation
Final Stage 1 & Stage 2 audit by accredited certification body

faqs.question: How long is the ISO 9001 certificate valid?
faqs.answer: ISO 9001 certificate is valid for 3 years, subject to annual surveillance audits.

faqs.question: How fast can PRV assist in getting certified?
faqs.answer: With PRV fast-track support, documentation and audit readiness can be completed in 10 to 15 working days.

services.comparisons: ISO 9001 is a generic quality management standard applicable to any industry, whereas IATF 16949 is specialized strictly for automotive supply chain manufacturers.
prv_support: Customized SOP and Quality Manual creation

services.definition: ISO 14001:2015 specifies the requirements for an Environmental Management System (EMS) to help organizations reduce waste, fulfill legal compliance obligations, and enhance environmental performance.
purpose: Control environmental impact of operations
Ensure full statutory compliance with Pollution Board norms
Optimize energy, water, and raw material utilization
Enhance corporate ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) profile
who_needs_it: Manufacturing plants, chemical and textile industries
Construction, mining, and energy generation companies
Organizations seeking international buyer clearances
benefits: Reduction in waste disposal and effluent treatment costs
Protection against legal penalties from CPCB/SPCB authorities
Improved brand image among eco-conscious global clients
process: Internal EMS Audit & Mock Emergency Drills
documents: Pollution Board NOC (Consent to Establish / Operate)
Hazardous Waste Disposal Records & ETP/STP Logs

faqs.question: Does ISO 14001 replace Pollution Control Board NOCs?
faqs.answer: No. ISO 14001 helps you maintain and verify compliance with Pollution Board NOCs and environmental laws, but does not replace legal approvals.

services.comparisons: ISO 14001 focuses on environmental sustainability, whereas ISO 45001 focuses on workplace occupational health and employee safety.

services.definition: ISO 45001:2018 is the international standard for Occupational Health and Safety (OH&S) management systems, designed to prevent work-related injuries, illnesses, and fatal accidents.
purpose: Provide safe and healthy workplaces for employees
Identify and mitigate workplace hazards and risks
Ensure compliance with Factory Act and labor laws
Reduce workplace accidents, downtime, and compensation claims
who_needs_it: Heavy manufacturing, steel, automotive, and chemical plants
Construction, infrastructure, and mining contractors
Logistics, warehouse, and high-risk operational facilities
benefits: Significant reduction in workplace lost-time accidents (LTI)
Lower insurance premiums and legal liabilities
Boosted employee morale and safety culture
process: Safety Policy, SOPs, and PPE protocols setup
Emergency response plan & mock drills execution
Internal Safety Audit & Safety Committee Review
documents: Accident/Incident Investigation Logs & PPE Issue Logs

faqs.question: Is ISO 45001 mandatory by law?
faqs.answer: While ISO 45001 is a voluntary standard, many top corporate clients and international buyers make it mandatory for high-risk industrial suppliers.

services.comparisons: ISO 45001 replaced the older OHSAS 18001 standard and integrates seamlessly with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 as part of an Integrated Management System (IMS).

services.definition: ISO 22000:2018 is the international standard for Food Safety Management Systems (FSMS), incorporating HACCP principles to ensure food safety across the entire supply chain.
purpose: Ensure food safety from farm to fork
Identify and control food safety hazards (Biological, Chemical, Physical)
Comply with FSSAI regulations and global food trade standards
who_needs_it: Food manufacturing, processing, and packaging companies
Hotels, commercial kitchens, catering services, and cold chains
Food exporters, agricultural processors, and beverage firms
benefits: Eliminates food contamination risks and product recalls
Essential credential for selling to major supermarket chains and exports
Complements and elevates basic FSSAI licensing
process: HACCP hazard analysis & Critical Control Point (CCP) setup
FSMS manual drafting and hygiene SOP training

faqs.question: Is ISO 22000 different from HACCP?
faqs.answer: HACCP is a food safety system framework focused on critical control points, whereas ISO 22000 integrates HACCP into a broader business management framework.

services.comparisons: FSSAI is a legal statutory requirement in India, while ISO 22000 is an internationally recognized quality standard for global export and corporate buyers.

services.definition: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 is the world's leading standard for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS), helping organizations protect data assets, customer privacy, and IT infrastructure.
purpose: Protect intellectual property, financial data, and personal data
Prevent cyber attacks, data breaches, and insider threats
Ensure compliance with IT Act, GDPR, and data protection laws
who_needs_it: IT & Software Development companies, SaaS providers
BPOs, KPOs, FinTech, and healthcare data processors
E-commerce platforms and cloud service vendors
benefits: Mandatory requirement for international IT clients and US/EU contracts
Prevents costly data breach fines and reputational damage
Builds high trust with institutional enterprise clients
process: Statement of Applicability (SoA) setup across 93 controls
ISMS Policy & Access Control SOP drafting
documents: Access Control, Backup & Disaster Recovery Plans

faqs.question: How long does ISO 27001 implementation take?
faqs.answer: Typically 30 to 60 days depending on IT infrastructure complexity, supported fast-track by PRV templates.

services.comparisons: ISO 27001 covers overall information security management systems, while SOC 2 is an audit framework specifically tailored for US cloud and service providers.

services.definition: ISO 22301:2019 is the international standard for Business Continuity Management Systems (BCMS), ensuring businesses can continue operating during unexpected disruptions or disasters.
purpose: Build organizational resilience against cyber threats, power outages, and disasters
Protect business reputation and maintain client delivery SLA during crises
who_needs_it: Data centers, telecom operators, financial institutions, and critical IT vendors
benefits: Minimized downtime financial losses
Enhanced customer and stakeholder confidence in crisis management

faqs.question: What is the difference between Disaster Recovery (DR) and BCMS?
faqs.answer: DR focuses on restoring IT systems, while BCMS covers the entire business operation recovery including personnel, facilities, and processes.

services.comparisons: ISO 22301 complements ISO 27001 by expanding IT resilience into overall business operational continuity.

services.definition: ISO 50001:2018 specifies requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and improving an Energy Management System (EnMS).
purpose: Systematically reduce energy consumption, power bills, and greenhouse gas emissions
who_needs_it: Energy-intensive manufacturing units (Steel, Cement, Glass, Chemicals, Paper)
benefits: Significant annual power and fuel cost savings
Demonstrated carbon neutrality commitment

faqs.question: Does ISO 50001 require expensive new machinery?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Most energy savings come from process optimizations, waste heat recovery, and efficient operational controls.

services.comparisons: ISO 50001 focuses strictly on energy efficiency, while ISO 14001 covers overall environmental waste and compliance.

services.definition: ISO 13485:2016 specifies requirements for a Quality Management System for medical devices and related services.
purpose: Ensure quality, safety, and regulatory compliance of medical devices across design and manufacturing
who_needs_it: Medical device manufacturers, surgical tool makers, and diagnostic equipment providers
benefits: Mandatory requirement for CDSCO licensing in India and global CE / FDA exports
Guaranteed product sterility, traceability, and safety compliance
process: Device risk classification & Design Controls setup
documents: Device Master Record (DMR) & Device History Record (DHR)

faqs.question: Is ISO 9001 enough for medical device manufacturing?
faqs.answer: No. Medical devices require ISO 13485 due to strict regulatory requirements, cleanroom controls, and risk management protocols.

services.comparisons: ISO 13485 incorporates ISO 9001 structure but adds stringent medical regulatory and safety requirements.

services.definition: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 specifies general requirements for the competence, impartiality, and consistent operation of testing and calibration laboratories.
purpose: Demonstrate technical competence and produce precise, internationally accepted test results
who_needs_it: Independent testing & calibration labs, in-house industrial QC testing labs
benefits: NABL Accreditation eligibility in India
Global acceptance of laboratory test certificates

faqs.question: Is ISO 17025 an accreditation or certification?
faqs.answer: ISO 17025 leads to Accreditation (such as NABL in India), proving technical competence, whereas standard ISOs are certifications.

services.comparisons: ISO 9001 assesses operational management quality, while ISO 17025 specifically accredits lab technical competence and measurement accuracy.

services.definition: IATF 16949:2016 is the global quality management standard for the automotive industry, established by the International Automotive Task Force.
purpose: Ensure continuous defect prevention and reduction of variation in automotive supply chains
who_needs_it: Automobile component manufacturers, tier-1, tier-2, and tier-3 automotive suppliers
benefits: Mandatory requirement for supplying directly to Automotive OEMs (Tata, Maruti, Hyundai, Mahindra, etc.)
Drastic reduction in scrap, rework, and warranty claims
process: Implementation of Core Tools (APQP, PPAP, FMEA, MSA, SPC)
Internal Audit by qualified IATF auditor

faqs.question: Can a new factory get IATF 16949 certified directly?
faqs.answer: A unit needs at least 12 months of automotive manufacturing data, or can obtain a Letter of Conformance (LOC) if newly established.

services.comparisons: ISO 9001 is a basic quality standard, while IATF 16949 is an advanced automotive standard requiring mandatory APQP, FMEA, and PPAP core tools.

services.definition: SEDEX (Supplier Ethical Data Exchange) and SMETA (SEDEX Members Ethical Trade Audit) evaluate ethical, labor, health & safety, and environmental standards in supply chains.
purpose: Verify ethical trade, worker welfare, and workplace safety for global retail buyers
who_needs_it: Garment, textile, handicrafts, food packaging, and manufacturing exporters supplying to global brands (Walmart, Target, Disney, H&M, etc.)
benefits: Unlocks vendor onboarding with premier international retail buyers
Single audit report accepted by thousands of global brands on SEDEX platform
process: Pre-audit ethical & labor compliance gap analysis by PRV
Corrective action on workplace safety, wages, and working hours
documents: Fire NOC & First Aid / Safety Officer Records

faqs.question: What is the difference between 2-Pillar and 4-Pillar SMETA?
faqs.answer: 2-Pillar covers Labor Standards and Health & Safety. 4-Pillar adds Environmental Assessment and Business Ethics.

services.comparisons: ISO standards focus on internal quality/management systems, whereas SEDEX/SMETA is a social ethical audit requested directly by international buyers.

services.definition: FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India) licensing and registration is the statutory requirement for all food business operators (FBOs) in India.
purpose: Ensure food products meet statutory hygiene and safety standards
who_needs_it: Food manufacturers, repackers, distributors, wholesalers, restaurants, and cloud kitchens
benefits: 100% legal compliance preventing heavy statutory fines and shop closures
Customer confidence and access to e-commerce food delivery platforms
process: Turnover & business capability evaluation (Basic / State / Central License)
FoSCoS portal application submission with PRV guidance
Hygiene rating audit and document verification
documents: PAN, Aadhaar, GST & Business Address proof
Plant layout blueprint & List of machinery
Water testing report from NABL lab

faqs.question: When is a Central FSSAI License required?
faqs.answer: Central FSSAI is required for 100% export units, head offices operating across multiple states, or businesses with turnover exceeding ₹20 Crores.

services.comparisons: FSSAI is mandatory government licensing, whereas ISO 22000 is an optional international quality excellence standard.

services.definition: Lean, 5S, and Kaizen are operational excellence methodologies aimed at eliminating waste (Muda), standardizing workplaces, and driving continuous daily process improvements.
purpose: Eliminate 7 Deadly Wastes (Overproduction, Waiting, Transport, Inventory, Motion, Over-processing, Defects)
Establish clean, organized, and visual shopfloors
Boost machine uptime (OEE) and operational efficiency
who_needs_it: Manufacturing plants facing high rejection rates, inventory clutter, or production bottlenecks
benefits: Direct cost reduction and profit maximization
20% to 40% increase in productivity and throughput
Drastic reduction in shopfloor search time and accidents
process: Shopfloor Gemba Walk & Diagnostic Audit by PRV experts
5S Implementation (Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain)
Kaizen workshop & suggestion scheme rollout for workers
Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and bottleneck elimination
documents: Kaizen Sheet Templates & Before/After Impact Reports

faqs.question: How long does it take to see results from 5S and Kaizen?
faqs.answer: Visual shopfloor transformation is visible within 7 to 14 days of PRV hands-on implementation.

services.comparisons: ISO standardizes existing procedures, whereas Lean & 5S actively clean, optimize, and speed up operational workflows.

services.definition: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) and National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) are Government of India schemes promoting industrial apprenticeship and stipend subsidies.
purpose: Provide industry-ready trained technical workforce while availing government stipend financial reimbursements
who_needs_it: Manufacturing companies, engineering firms, and commercial establishments employing apprentices
benefits: Govt reimbursement of stipend expenses (up to ₹1,500/month per apprentice under NAPS)
Exemption from ESI and PF contributions on apprentice stipends
Access to skilled fresh talent pool
process: Apprentice vacancy posting and contract generation
documents: Company PAN, GST & Provident Fund (PF) registration

faqs.question: Is PF and ESI applicable to NATS/NAPS apprentices?
faqs.answer: No. Statutory PF and ESI contributions are not applicable to apprentices under NATS/NAPS, saving significant employer costs.

services.comparisons: NATS is focused on Diploma & Degree engineering graduates, while NAPS covers ITI and non-engineering apprentices.

services.definition: PRV's flagship comprehensive business transformation program combining ISO systems, Lean manufacturing, 5S shopfloor organization, leadership coaching, and financial profit optimization.
purpose: Transform traditional businesses into high-profit, system-driven, professional enterprises
who_needs_it: Business Owners, Directors, and MSME Promoters seeking hands-off management and rapid scaling
benefits: Complete transition from owner-driven to system-driven operations
Direct profit margin expansion and waste elimination
Ready for corporate expansion, franchising, or investor funding
process: Customized 6 to 12 month Transformation Roadmap design
Weekly PRV expert on-site coaching & implementation
Quarterly review with Directors & ROI audit
documents: Standard Operating Procedures across all departments

faqs.question: What is the duration of the Master Business Excellence Program?
faqs.answer: Programs typically range from 6 months to 12 months with continuous on-site handholding.

services.comparisons: Single certifications solve standard compliance, whereas the Master Program transforms the entire business end-to-end.
